sample_unit: patients (discharge instructions drafted for each; 202 documents)

links.outcome: Expert-rated quality of discharge instructions by junior physicians with versus without LLM assistance
links.effect: AI-assisted instructions scored significantly higher on all 5 dimensions and overall (Bonferroni-adjusted P<.001), effect sizes r=0.741-0.927; 99% (100/101) improved by at least 1 point overall.
links.quote: Compared with resident-only instructions, AI-assisted instructions received significantly higher scores across 5 evaluation dimensions and the overall evaluation (all Bonferroni-adjusted P<.001), with large effect sizes (r=0.741-0.927).

unlisted_practices: LLM-assisted drafting of discharge instructions by junior physicians, with expert Likert scoring of completeness, accuracy, safety, clarity, and personalization
Stratified analysis of AI-assisted document quality by CKD stage (case complexity)

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates junior physicians drafting discharge instructions with vs without LLM assistance (human-AI collaboration) on retrospective patient cases.

primary.practice: AI-assisted clinical documentation drafting compared to unassisted drafting
